description: Places every handwritten functions/src module by tool/architecture/functions_context_map.json (issue #1350) and checks its imports: platform imports only platform, domain code never imports a surface, a surface never imports another, domain contexts import only earlier contexts; and every collection is written only from the writerContext its tool/contracts/firestore_contract/collections/<id>.json names. Today's context-order imports and cross-context writes are listed one by one in the map (knownContextOrderImports, knownCrossContextWrites); any other violation fails, and so does a listed one that no longer happens. A generated dispatch registry (issue #2451) is the one module that may import any context; tool/architecture/generate_dispatch_registries.mjs --check fails when one is stale, registers an unlisted source, or is not re-exported by its area. The Functions CI lane runs it, so it blocks Required CI.

rules.title: Functions code is layered into platform, domain contexts and surfaces, and one context writes each collection
rules.instruction: Place new functions/src modules under functions/src/platform/, functions/src/domain/<context>/ or functions/src/surfaces/<surface>/ (or a legacy placement in the map). Domain code never imports a surface; shared helpers go to the owning domain context or platform. Write a collection only from its registry writerContext; other contexts call the owning context's functions inside their transaction. Never add an entry to knownContextOrderImports or knownCrossContextWrites; remove an entry when its violation is fixed. Register dispatched projections with defineProjections and regenerate the registries with node tool/architecture/generate_dispatch_registries.mjs; never edit a .generated.ts registry by hand.
